author: Midwinter Minis
description:
I asked my Golden Demon winning pal @lpp_insta how we would paint metallic silver armour if he ONLY had 4 steps, and this is what he did...

- Basecoat silver
- Purple tint from below
- Green tiny from above
- Drybrush bright silver

LEGEND

Full video with 9 other silver recipes https://youtu.be/Of863BJjCmU

title: Secret 4 step silver recipe from a Golden Demon winner

author: Midwinter Minis
description:
A little throwback to my first ever video. Crackling texture paint is a great way to get a decaying, rotting metal look on your minis.

- Prime metallic silver
- Apply crackle paint (chip off as it dries)
- Dark wash
- Drybrush bright silver

Full video with 9 other silver recipes https://youtu.be/Of863BJjCmU

title: super realistic rotting metal

author: Midwinter Minis
description:
WITCHCRAFT

- Spray/brush on GSW Chrome
- Sponge thinned black
- Recess shade with Broadsword Silver

Paint the rest of the details and you're done!

Full video with 9 other silver recipes https://youtu.be/Of863BJjCmU

author: Midwinter Minis
description:
- Spray metallic silver
- Apply Dirty Down Rust (wipe away with wet cotton swab)
- Drybrush bright silver

Such an easy way to paint up your rusted, post apocalyptic minis!

Full video with 9 other silver recipes https://youtu.be/Of863BJjCmU

author: Midwinter Minis
description:
An easy way to get the mottled look of galvanised steel on your minis:
- Prime black
- Overbrush dark metallic
- Sponge gunmetal
- Light sponge bright silver

DONE. Full video with 9 other silver recipes https://youtu.be/Of863BJjCmU

author: Midwinter Minis
description:
Paint your silver armoured minis without even using a brush!

- Spray gloss black
- Spray gunmetal from zenithal arc
- Spray bright silver from directly above

Paint the rest of the details and you're done!
